title: Hnefatafl
experiment: Copenhagen Hnefatafl on 11x11 against an alpha-beta opponent: king to a corner or capture the king, custodian captures, restricted throne and corners, undo, hint, easy/normal/hard. The gate runs 39 rule checks on hand-built positions, then one full AI-vs-AI game (both sides 2 plies, fixed seed) that is replayed in a fresh engine. The AI's defenders are stronger than its attackers. Shieldwall capture, the edge-fort win (cautious test) and the encirclement win are implemented.
author: gamecraft: rules engine and search written for this repo (the old skeleton and ai-games-collection were references only)
